chassis_bottom.description: 260 mm flat-to-flat hex deck, 5 mm PETG. Six Ø44 yaw wells at the hex vertices; each AK40 stands on the plate output-DOWN, bolted by 3x M2.5x8 from below into its front-case taps on Ø47.5. Also carries the M3x50 standoff square, per-leg harness slots, battery strap slots, XT90 pass-through. Prints flat, no supports.

chassis_top.description: 260 mm hex top plate, 4 mm PETG: Ø80 centre access hole, standoff square, Pi 5 mount pattern east of centre.

standoff.description: M3 x 50 F-F brass standoff at (+-40, +-40) carrying the plate stack across the 50 mm gap. COTS.

screw_m3x8.description: Plate-stack screw into the M3x50 F-F standoffs: 4 from below the bottom plate, 4 from above the top plate. COTS.

battery.description: 6S 5000 mAh LiPo (~155 x 48 x 55) velcro'd under the belly; must stay inside r~95 mm of centre or the swinging hip actuators find it. COTS.

pi5.description: Pi 5 8 GB + active cooler on the top plate; 3x CANable 2.0 USB-CAN hang off it (one bus per leg pair). COTS.

screw_m25x12.description: Raspberry Pi 5 mount: up through the top plate into the Pi standoff stack (58 x 49 mm hole pattern). COTS.

actuator.description: CubeMars AK40-10 KV170 QDD: Ø53 x 40.2, 190 g, 1.3/4.1 N*m rated/peak, CAN + MIT mode. Mock cylinder in the viz (with output pilot bore); real interface dims from the official 2D drawing, caliper verification pending.

coxa_link.description: One print per leg: Ø40 yaw-output hub (turns inside the chassis Ø44 well, 3x M2.5x6 + Ø14.85 pilot boss into the flange) + arm plate + hip rear-mount wall (Ø37 boss recess, 4x M2.5x8, side gussets). The hip body hangs 1.5 mm below the arm plate -- that clearance set HIP_AXIS_DROP=66.

femur_link.description: Flat 6 mm plate: hip-flange hub (pilot boss + 3x M2.5x6 counterbored) on one end, knee rear mount (Ø37 recess + 4x M2.5x8) on the other. Actuator bodies alternate sides of the plate, Mini-Cheetah style.

tibia_yoke.description: Knee-flange hub + web + Ø12 CF tube socket (30 mm epoxied bore, 2x Ø2.5 roll-pin cross-holes). Socket top sits below the Ø53 knee body sweep.

tibia_tube.description: Ø12 x Ø10 roll-wrapped CF tube, 102 mm cut. Epoxied 30 mm into the yoke socket, pinned twice. COTS stock.

foot_boot.description: TPU 95A boot pressed over the tube end; Ø11.7 bore = 0.3 mm interference, 18 mm solid rounded tip.

screw_m25x6.description: Flange-hub screw: 3 per output flange (Ø27 PCD, M2.5 tapped x3 deep). 6 mm length gives 3.0 mm grip through the printed hub cb + full 3.0 mm tap engagement. Blue threadlocker. COTS.

screw_m25x8.description: Case-mount screw: 3x front case ring per yaw (Ø47.5 PCD, chassis well) + 4x rear case ring per hip/knee (Ø47 PCD, coxa wall / femur plate). 4.5-4.7 mm into 5 mm deep case taps. Blue threadlocker. COTS.

pin_25x22.description: Tibia retention: 2 cross pins per leg through yoke socket + CF tube, backing up the epoxy bond against axial pull-out. COTS.
